requiredBehaviors.evidence: The skill makes a project-specific logo mandatory and ties it to purpose, audience and character.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: derive a matching favicon from the same visual system
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The favicon rule explicitly requires derivation from the same visual system as the logo.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: require a matching app icon because this is an app
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The skill requires a consistent app icon for installable apps, PWAs, mobile and desktop apps.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: derive the color strategy from project context and desired effect
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Color choices must be justified from project context, brand character, usage scene and intended effect.
Visible copy and microcopy must use the project's actual domain, audience and terminology.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: map the key visual to at least two of the three core project properties
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The key visual must graphically communicate at least two of the prioritized two to three project properties.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: treat logo favicon and app icon as unrelated assets
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The asset-family rule requires logo, favicon and app icon to form one recognizable system.
Arbitrary template or favorite colors are explicitly rejected without project rationale.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: use generic SaaS or AI copy
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Generic SaaS and AI placeholder copy is explicitly prohibited.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: accept a decorative key visual with no semantic mapping
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Pure decoration or arbitrary stock aesthetics are explicitly insufficient for the key visual.
